title: PopGen: Generating Semantically Diverse Populations for Zero-Shot Coordination
abstract: arXiv:2610.15969v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In multi-agent reinforcement learning, exposing a cooperator to partners with diverse strategies during training is key to better collaboration at test time. However, existing methods typically rely on trajectory-level proxies to measure diversity, which may label two distinct trajectories of the same strategy as diverse. Instead, our key insight is to leverage LLMs' ability to describe behaviorally distinct agents in environments, similar to how humans can recognize high-level strategies. To this end, we introduce PopGen, a framework that synthesizes semantically diverse agents from scratch using LLMs. PopGen first generates a diverse set of textual descriptions of agent behaviors, then translates each behavior into a code policy that can be executed within the environment. translated_title: PopGen：为零样本协调生成语义多样化的智能体种群
translated_abstract: 在多智能体强化学习中，让协作者在训练期间接触具有多样化策略的伙伴，是提升其测试时协作能力的关键。然而，现有方法通常依赖轨迹层面的代理指标来衡量多样性，这可能把属于同一策略的两条不同轨迹错误地判定为“多样”。与此不同，我们的关键洞察是利用大语言模型（LLM）描述环境中行为各异智能体的能力，就像人类能够识别高层策略一样。为此，我们提出了PopGen——一个利用LLM从零开始合成语义多样化智能体的框架。PopGen首先生成一组多样的智能体行为文本描述，然后将每种行为翻译为可在环境中执行的代码策略。我们证明，针对PopGen种群训练的协作者能够与未见过的伙伴实现稳健的零样本协作，并在各项指标上超越种群博弈基线方法。
tldr: PopGen利用大语言模型先生成多样化的智能体行为文本描述、再将其转化为可执行的代码策略，从而合成语义层面真正多样的种群，使协作者能够与未见伙伴实现更稳健的零样本协作。
en_tdlr: PopGen leverages LLMs to synthesize semantically diverse agent populations by first generating textual behavior descriptions and translating them into executable code policies, enabling cooperators to achieve robust zero-shot coordination with unseen partners.
